classes.name: Non-stimulant ADHD agents
classes.description: Non-stimulant ADHD agents: atomoxetine (Strattera), viloxazine ER (Qelbree), guanfacine ER (Intuniv), clonidine ER (Kapvay).
classes.plainDescription: A daily ADHD medicine that is not a stimulant.

records.verificationNote: Read directly from Highmark Comprehensive Formulary drug-search pages for the ADHD Nri-Type and Alpha-2 Receptor Agonist classes. Generic guanfacine ER 24-hour tablets (1-4 mg) are Tier 1 with a quantity limit, no PA. Intuniv brand, Strattera brand, Qelbree, Kapvay are PA-flagged (Tier 3). Generic atomoxetine capsules are Tier 3 with a quantity limit and no PA (covered at Tier 3 cost share). Generic clonidine ER 0.1 mg tablet is Tier 3 with no PA or QL flag. Strength and sig are a representative 2 mg dose at standard label dosing. [Sonnet check 2026-10-21: Highmark legend (re-read on the live site) defines Tier 3 as "Non-Formulary Drug" that closed-formulary members do not get, so "covered, higher cost share" was overstated and Tier 3 alternatives now carry that caveat. Spot-checked on the live site: Aimovig 140 mg/mL is Tier 2 + QL + PA; Concerta 18 mg is Tier 3 + QL, no PA; both match.]
